question: Should OpenClaw define and document a bundled dashboard builtin-widget authoring surface now, or defer this until the Wave 1 dashboard stack is accepted and corrected on main?
rationale: The requested contract exists only in open contributor PRs today, and documenting it would create a public contributor API plus browser security expectations before maintainers have accepted the underlying dashboard product boundary.

options.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Settles
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not start implementation until the prerequisite dashboard PRs land or maintainers choose the final widget contract.

options.title: Sponsor The SDK Now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve the dashboard widget direction and request a docs/templates PR against the current stack shape.

options.title: Move Examples Out Of Core
options.body: If the dashboard remains experimental or external, keep starter examples in a plugin or ClawHub package instead of OpenClaw core docs.

recommendation.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Settles
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open but do not start implementation until the prerequisite dashboard PRs land or maintainers choose the final widget contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history-backed connection to the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the product boundary this dashboard work would extend.
